title: Add workparent flag and column
description: Implemented workparent column showing the directory name of the workparent (without path) for worktrees. For Git worktrees, parses .git file containing gitdir path. For Jujutsu worktrees, reads .jj/repo pointer file. Returns empty string for non-worktree repositories. Supports sorting by workparent column with None values sorted after Some values.

title: Add date flag for date format specification
description: Implemented --date flag for specifying date format string. Default format is ISO 8601. The date format string is accepted and stored for use by commit-date and change-date columns when they are implemented in their respective tickets.

title: Add change-date flag and column
description: Implemented change-date column showing the most recent file change date for each repository. Uses directory metadata to get modification time via std::fs::metadata().modified(). Formats date using chrono library with ISO 8601 format. Supports sorting by change-date column.

title: Add --reverse/-R flag for reversing sort order
description: Add --reverse/-R flag to reverse the sort order of results.
close_reason: Removed from spec - reverse functionality replaced with +/- suffixes on sort columns

title: Add all/-a flag for testing all directories
description: Implemented --all/-a flag using clap for argument parsing. When --all is specified, recursively scans current directory for subdirectories (excluding hidden directories starting with .) and tests each one. Maintains existing functionality for testing specific directories via positional arguments.

title: Add sort flag for sorting results
description: Implemented --sort flag for sorting by any column with comma-separated multiple sorts and +/- suffixes for direction. Currently supports sorting by: status, directory. Support for commit-date, change-date, and workparent columns will be added in their respective tickets. Sort specifications are parsed with +/- suffix for ascending/descending, and default to ascending if no suffix.

title: Add filter flag for type filtering
description: Implemented --filter flag with comma-separated filters and - suffix for NOT. Filtering logic: positive filters are OR'd (show if any positive filter matches), negative filters are AND'd (exclude if any negative filter matches). When only negative filters exist, shows all entries except those matching the negative filters. Supports filter types: git, jj, worktree, worktree-git, worktree-jj.

title: Add commit-date flag and column
description: Implemented commit-date column showing the most recent commit date for each repository. Uses git log -1 --format=%ci to fetch commit date for both Git and Jujutsu repositories. For Jujutsu worktrees, reads the .jj/repo pointer file to locate the actual git backend. Returns empty string for repositories with no commits. Supports sorting by commit-date column.

title: Implement basic Git and Jujutsu detection
description: Implemented basic detection logic in src/detect.rs using .jj and .git metadata. Jujutsu worktrees detected by checking if .jj/repo is a file (pointer) vs directory (main). Git worktrees detected by checking if .git is a file (pointer) vs directory (main). Priority: Jujutsu takes precedence over Git. Verified against example directories: compfuzor (git), compfuzor-x (worktree-git), niri-mcp (jj), niri-mcp-x (worktree-jj).

title: Add json flag for JSON output
description: Implemented --json flag to output results in JSON format as an array of objects with all columns as fields. Uses serde and serde_json libraries for serialization. JSON output includes all columns: status, directory, commit_date, change_date, workparent. When --json is specified, output is JSON array regardless of --format flag.

title: Add format flag for custom output format
description: Implemented --format flag for custom output format with interpolated columns. Currently supports columns: status, directory. Columns commit-date, change-date, workparent are supported but return empty strings until implemented in their respective tickets. Format string uses {column} syntax for interpolation (e.g., "{status} {directory}").

title: Command Options Epic
description: Implement all CLI command options for is-tree including sorting, filtering, formatting, and output options.
